mapper.update: UPDATE WMSSTCK SET TOT_QTY = NVL(TOT_QTY,0) + (#{INV_QTY}), ALLOC_QTY = NVL(ALLOC_QTY,0) + (#{INV_QTY}), CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_USER = #{USER_ID} WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND AGENT = (SELECT DECODE(PROCESS_TYPE, '1', 'KRKORE0001', AGENT) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND INV_SEQ = #{IK_SEQ})

UPDATE ICOMPODT A SET A.DI_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) WHERE A.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND (A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND STATUS <> 'D')

UPDATE ICOMIVDT A SET A.GR_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0), A.DELIVERY_QTY = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') IN ('1','3') THEN NVL((SELECT SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) ELSE A.DELIVERY_QTY END, A.DELIVERY_DATE = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') IN ('1','3') THEN '' ELSE A.DELIVERY_DATE END, A.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') IN ('1','3') THEN NULL ELSE A.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE END, A.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') IN ('1','3') THEN NULL ELSE A.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID END WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND (A.INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE =#{st_ware_house_code} AND BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND STATUS <> 'D')

UPDATE WMSIVDT WIDT SET WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), WIDT.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{USER_ID}, WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE = '', WIDT.DELIVERY_USER_ID = '', WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY = '', WIDT.DELIVERY_NO = '', WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = 0, WIDT.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID = NULL, WIDT.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE = NULL WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY <> 0
mapper.select:
/*selectMasterWmGiInvoiceNoPop*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = WIDT.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(WIDT.INV_DATE) AS INV_DATE, MAX(WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE) AS DELIVERY_DATE, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, DECODE(SUM(NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0)),SUM(NVL(WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,0)),'배송확정','출고') AS STATUS_TEXT, MAX(DECODE((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO), 'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반')) AS DOC_TEXT, MAX((SELECT MAX(ADD_USER_NAME) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PR_NO = WIDT.PR_NO)) AS ADD_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT MAX(ADD_USER_TEL) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PR_NO = WIDT.PR_NO)) AS ADD_USER_TEL, MAX((SELECT MAX(DELY_TO_LOCATION) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO)) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER,
MAX((SELECT MAX(NVL(PODT.GR_QTY,0)) FROM ICOMPODT PODT WHERE PODT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = WIDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D')) AS PODT_GR_QTY, MAX((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO)) AS DOC_TYPE, MAX((SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = WIDT.PO_SEQ)) LEGACY_PO_NO, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = WIDT.ADD_USER_ID)) ADD_USER_ID, MAX(WIDT.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL , MAX(DECODE(K.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y')) AS KTAG_RPT, --'Y'이면 K TAG 사용 고객사 (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(INV_NO),0,'N','Y') AS COURIER_TAG_YN FROM KEP_COURIER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.BUYER =WIDT.BUYER AND MNG.INV_NO = WIDT.INV_NO) AS COURIER_TAG_YN, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(MSG_KEY),0,'N','Y') AS HANJIN_TAG_YN FROM KEP_PARCEL_HJ_LB HJ WHERE HJ.MSG_KEY = WIDT.BUYER||WIDT.INV_NO ) AS HANJIN_TAG_YN FROM WMSIVDT WIDT , ( SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000054' --K TAG 사용 관리: 특수로직 ) K WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.BUYER = K.BUYER(+) GROUP BY WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO

SELECT WIDT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, WIDT.S_INV_NO AS GR_NO, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_DATE, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, NVL(WIDT.PO_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY, NVL(WIDT.LIST_PRICE,0) AS LIST_PRICE, NVL(WIDT.LIST_AMT,0) AS LIST_AMT, WIDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, WIDT.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, WIDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(WIDT.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,0) AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(WIDT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(WIDT.UNIT_AMT,0) AS UNIT_AMT, WIDT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, WIDT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(PODT.DI_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER AS BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, WIDT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, WIDT.INV_SEQ AS IK_SEQ, POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반') AS DOC_TEXT, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TEXT ,WIDT.CAR_NO ,(SELECT MAX(KTAG_QTY) FROM ICOMKTAG WHERE BUYER=WIDT.BUYER AND INV_NO=WIDT.INV_NO AND INV_SEQ=WIDT.INV_SEQ) AS KTAG_QTY FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND WIDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND WIDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND WIDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND WIDT.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND WIDT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND WIDT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND WIDT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND WIDT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND WIDT.S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND WIDT.S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO, WIDT.INV_SEQ

/*selectMasterWmGiInvoiceNoPopList*/ SELECT WIDT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, WIDT.S_INV_NO AS GR_NO, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_DATE,
WIDT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, NVL(WIDT.PO_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY, NVL(WIDT.LIST_PRICE,0) AS LIST_PRICE, NVL(WIDT.LIST_AMT,0) AS LIST_AMT, WIDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, WIDT.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, WIDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(WIDT.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,0) AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(WIDT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(WIDT.UNIT_AMT,0) AS UNIT_AMT, WIDT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, WIDT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(PODT.DI_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, POHD.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION,
PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK,
WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER AS BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, WIDT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, WIDT.INV_SEQ AS IK_SEQ,
POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TEXT, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반') AS DOC_TEXT, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI') || '('|| DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반') ||')' AS GUBUN_TEXT, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,WIDT.CAR_NO ,(SELECT MAX(KTAG_QTY) FROM ICOMKTAG WHERE BUYER=WIDT.BUYER AND INV_NO=WIDT.INV_NO AND INV_SEQ=WIDT.INV_SEQ) AS KTAG_QTY ,F_GET_MSDS_INFO(PODT.BUYER, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,1) AS MSDS_NO ,NVL(WIDT.BUYER_GR_QTY,0) AS BUYER_GR_QTY FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND WIDT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND WIDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND WIDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND WIDT.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND WIDT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND WIDT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND WIDT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND WIDT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND WIDT.S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND WIDT.S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO, WIDT.INV_SEQ
mapper.update: UPDATE WMSIVDT WIDT SET WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), WIDT.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{USER_ID}, WIDT.STATUS = 'D', WIDT.SND_CHK = 'N' WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'

UPDATE ICOMIVDT A SET A.WMS_IVK_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.INV_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND (A.INV_NO,A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} ) AND STATUS <> 'D'

UPDATE ICOMPODT A SET A.IV_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.INV_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND (A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_ware_house_code} AND BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND INV_NO = #{st_IK_NO} ) AND STATUS <> 'D'
